svg.title: Pitzen knot — how to tie it
svg.desc: Pitzen knot, in 5 steps. Pass the tag through the hook eye and fold it back under the standing line, pinching the small loop that forms at the eye. Wrap the tag around both parallel lines four times, working back DOWN toward the hook eye. Pass the tag through the small loop you are still pinching at the eye. Wet it and pull the standing line — the knot slides down and seats against the eye, often with an audible pop. Trim the tag close.
svg.text: ~95% of line strength · tippet to fly
